idea: Filter knapsack-generated multisets with necessary cumulative-capacity conditions before running the expensive packability tests. The number of squares with side > 1/j is at most (j−1)², and the total side of squares exceeding 1/2 in any row band is at most 1. Also apply an area bound per size threshold, so only plausible multisets reach exact packing.
